annotations.title: Find court, bank and government auctions, scored

description: Foreclosure, court, tax and bank auctions from Germany, Spain, Italy and India in one format: price, valuation, debts that stay with the property, total cost, area, price per m2, possession (vacant or occupied), auction dates, deposit, seller, case number, documents and photos. Every lot is scored 0 to 100 against similar lots nearby and against the budget, place and dates given, with strengths, watch-outs and its rank among peers. Use for finding below-market property, screening distressed assets and auction alerts. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/auctions-radar on your Apify account (about $0.015 per lot; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

asset_types.description: Kinds of asset (default property and vehicles).

auction_within_days.description: Only auctions in the next N days.

budget_currency.description: EUR or INR, or any currency with a daily reference rate.

location.description: A town, postcode or address to measure distance from.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

radius_km.description: Only lots within this distance of location.
